name: jyu_slam_front
desc: Same character, same size, same colors and cream pattern. New pose: he turns to face straight toward the viewer, standing with feet planted apart, both hands on his hips with elbows out, the broad chest and huge round belly pushed forward. The head keeps the same thick angular black eyebrows and closed mouth, the chin tucked a little and the half-lidded eyes looking down at the viewer with a heavy, smug, condescending gaze. Thick paint dripping. Same outline and pixel art style.
